scope: Additive read-only experiment-design review; no live workload or cloud changes; GitHub issue GETs only
outcome: Linearity remains unestablished; denominator and comparison protocol need owner decision. Current dynamic V3 is not a guaranteed one/four-task comparison; the criterion is not established to be universally impossible.

githubReadbacks.interpretation: Incorporates verification-plan scenarios/thresholds; abbreviated checkbox names error rate and visible scale-out, not an exact linearity formula; no denominator clarification or waiver in retrieved comment.
Requires metric/threshold definitions, offered versus achieved distinction, accurate failed/inconclusive labels and limitations. No rerun/infrastructure authorization.
Infrastructure/dashboard/two-AZ placement closure is not a measured linearity pass.

criterion.wording: Achieved throughput at four tasks at least 80% of ideal scaling from one task
criterion.T1: Comparable measured achieved throughput with exactly one current commerce task; capacity versus finite workload reference is not specified precisely enough
criterion.T4: Comparable measured achieved throughput with exactly four healthy routable current commerce tasks

currentWorkload.candidateMeaning: Historical monolith largest tested passing rate; saturation unobserved; not current distributed one-task achieved capacity
currentWorkload.policyEstimateLimit: Steady-state arithmetic only; not ECS trajectory guarantee, task capacity, or linearity evidence

ceilingInterpretation.assumptions: Sustained settled window, offered load <=600 RPS, no backlog-draining completion burst; actual goodput may be lower
ceilingInterpretation.ifApprovedComparableT1Equals200: Unchanged 600-RPS experiment cannot demonstrate required 640 achieved RPS
ceilingInterpretation.ifComparableCurrentCapacityIndependently: 600-RPS experiment cannot establish 80% capacity efficiency; 640 would be a minimum and could be insufficient for higher true capacity
ceilingInterpretation.notPermitted: Treat monolith candidate as current T1, pick a lower demand-limited denominator after the fact, or use transient completion bursts as sustainable capacity
